name: sunra
description: Connect Sunra to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Sunra MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Sunra to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aI images, videos, audio and 3D using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Sunra workspace.
Find anything in Sunra that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aI images, videos, audio and 3D in Sunra.
